SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.title, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.status, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.create_time AS createTime, c.name AS categoryName, u.username AS username, u.avatar AS avatar, pi.image_url AS mainImage, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isFavorite FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.sort_order = ( SELECT MIN(pi2.sort_order) FROM product_image pi2 WHERE pi2.product_id = p.id )
LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.product_id = p.id AND f.user_id = #{query.loginUserId}
LEFT JOIN favorite f ON 1 = 0
WHERE p.status = 1
AND p.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
